evals.prompt: Use $abstract-watercolor-image-v1 to turn this group photo into bright watercolor color blocks. Keep the group arrangement but remove human features.
evals.expected_output: Uses Photo Input Mode, preserves broad placement, overlap and gesture, removes facial and anatomical detail, generates a watercolor-block image, and checks that it does not drift into cartoon, vector, or photorealistic rendering.

evals.prompt: Keep the embrace readable through shape overlap, but make the people only abstract painted masses.
evals.expected_output: Reduces figures to a few irregular watercolor blocks each, keeps the central interaction readable, and avoids faces, hands, clothing detail, outlines, typography and realistic anatomy.

evals.prompt: Analyze these watercolor references and separate fixed rules from variable rules. Give me a reusable prompt without copying exact subjects.
evals.expected_output: Uses Reference Analysis Mode, reports observed evidence, fixed system, variable system and sample residue, then returns a source-safe reusable prompt and avoid list without claiming an image was generated.

evals.prompt: Only give me the final prompt for a bright abstract watercolor crowd scene. No image.
evals.expected_output: Uses Prompt-only Mode, returns a concrete production prompt, variation recipe and negative constraints, and does not imply generation or inspection.

evals.prompt: Make this photo much simpler. No clock, no text, no faces, no outlines, just watercolor blocks.
evals.expected_output: Explicitly enforces the hard constraints, removes literal detail, uses large hand-painted masses and visible paper, and rejects any introduced clock, text, iconography, facial features or vector outlines.

evals.prompt: Turn this busy street scene into the same watercolor style while keeping only the main visual balance.
evals.expected_output: Extracts roughly 5 to 12 dominant masses, removes minor architecture and signage, preserves left-right and foreground-background balance, and keeps the image sparse and abstract.
